messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: elevated latency & CPU on `rerank` route across a subset of hosts, triggered at 2141594200. Auto-shed attempted but QPS still > SLO. Paging eng-oncall.
micah: on it. looking at the rerank cluster now — thanks for the ping. initial hypothesis: large multi-pass rerank jobs from a handful of tenants.
anya: linking the dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/rerank-latency (spike at ~2141594120)
micah: logs show repeated `/v1/rerank` calls with batch_size=128 and `top_k=100` from tenant t-rc-prod-07, sustained for ~6m. tail of logs:
```
2024-11-12T03:16:12Z request_id=abc123 tenant=t-rc-prod-07 route=rerank batch_size=128 duration_ms=4200
2024-11-12T03:17:05Z request_id=def456 tenant=t-rc-prod-07 route=rerank batch_size=128 duration_ms=4500
```
samir: customer is doing a nightly re-score that normally runs at low qps but seems to have accidentally parallelized across shards. Impacting other tenants on same slice.
leah: symptoms: chat endpoints degraded (p50->p95 shift), some 503s for lower-tier chat customers. CS reports ~5 customer-reported errors so far.
cs-bot: Notified affected customers tagged: @acct-ozeta, @acct-lyre.zen. Sending templated update.
micah: immediate mitigation options: 1) throttle per-tenant QPS for rerank route; 2) reduce global per-route capacity for rerank (surgical carve to chat); 3) disable heavy rerank flags for lower tiers; 4) route heavy rerank to smaller model variant.
anya: recommend combo: carve back 30% of rerank capacity and apply per-tenant hard limit of 10 QPS for suspicious tenants first. Will also enable model-fallback to `rerank-small-v2` for anyone exceeding limit.
micah: making config change now. patch:
```
# /config/routes/2024-11-12/rerank-qos.json
{
  "route": "rerank",
  "surgical_carve": {"target": "chat_pool", "percent": 30},
  "per_tenant_limits": {"t-rc-prod-07": 10, "default": 200}
}
```
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook step 4 executed: applied per-route carve and tenant QPS clamp. Monitor for error spike. https://runbook.redwood.ai/runbooks/rerank-qos
samir: applied tenant clamp and carved capacity off rerank; also disabled `rerank-deep-pass` feature flag for non-enterprise tiers (`release/flag/disable-rerank-deep` rolled out).
leah: initial numbers: rerank latency median down 40%, chat p95 improved but still above SLO for ~2 tenants. 503s decreasing.
micah: added temporary header to 429 responses so clients see reason: `X-RateLimit-Reason: rerank-qps-clamp` — helps CS triage.
cs-bot: Sent second update to customers: "We applied emergency rate limits to rerank requests for stability; enterprise customers unaffected unless notified. We'll follow up with timeline."
anya: note — also set routing policy so that callers on rerank who exceed tenant cap get fallback to `rerank-small-v2` (lower quality but faster).
samir: rolling back the feature flag now for enterprise-only to limit customer impact. command:
`/flags set rerank-deep-pass scope=enterprise only`
micah: ok next steps: watch for regen of the spike. If t-rc-prod-07 continues, we may need to apply a short-term hard disable for rerank on that tenant and queue retries.
leah: monitoring dashboards: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/alerts -> rerank qps down to normal for most hosts, a couple still showing elevated CPU (hosts r-12,r-13)
micah: moving to graceful degradation: sending a background job to requeue heavy rerank requests into batch windows (non-interactive). Putting that tenant into `deferred-rerank` mode.
ops-runbook-bot: Step: put tenant into deferred mode executed. Tenant t-rc-prod-07 flagged: deferred=true.
cs-bot: Notified t-rc-prod-07 engineering contact privately, asked for root cause and timeline to reduce parallelism.
anya: After deferred + carve + fallback, chat p95 back under SLO at +4m. Customer-facing incidents: minor. We'll keep QPS clamp for 30m and then reassess.
micah: Preparing on-call handoff to @samir at 2141594700 — I'll summarize what we did in the incident channel.
samir: taking over. key state: rerank QPS clamp active, `rerank-deep-pass` disabled for non-enterprise, tenant t-rc-prod-07 deferred, fallback to `rerank-small-v2` enabled. Monitoring graphs linked.
leah: docs: mitigation steps saved: /ops/incidents/2141594200-rerank-mitigation.md
micah: closing note: gradual restore plan — re-enable deep-pass for non-enterprise only after tenant fixes and 60m of stable metrics. I'll watch next 30m then hand to infra for capacity tuning.
samir: acknowledged. if we see another surge, escalate to capacity team to spin up extra rerank nodes and isolate tenant slice.
micah: thanks team :thumbsup:
ops-runbook-bot: Incident resolved? false -> ongoing. will update every 5m.
samir: logging final handoff at 2141594800 — continuing monitoring, will post resolution when metrics stable.
